challenge: Consumer preparation could not verify the exact package on Windows because its supposed script-disabled pack still executed prepare.
observedFailure: npm pack ran prepare in the reduced distribution copy and failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before comparing a valid archive.
resolution: Compare the supplied archive manifest directly with bounded clean tracked distribution bytes and never execute npm or lifecycle scripts during verification.
knownLimitations: This remains package preparation only; npm publication and deployment and authenticated Convex adoption are not claimed.
